pages.text: Then the Sun warms the water again, and the cycle starts all over.

stories.title: Viruses and Bacteria
learning_objectives: Viruses and bacteria are tiny germs
Some germs can make people sick
Not all bacteria are harmful
The immune system helps fight germs
Healthy habits help protect us
